skills.name: Explain Code
skills.description: Explain source code in beginner-friendly steps.
skills.prompt: Explain the following code step by step. Identify its purpose, important functions, data flow, dependencies, and possible pitfalls. Assume I am learning.

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: Review code for correctness, security, maintainability and tests.
skills.prompt: Review the provided code. Prioritize correctness and security, identify concrete defects with file/line references when available, suggest minimal fixes, and propose tests. Do not claim tests were run unless results are supplied.

skills.name: Debug Assistant
skills.description: Turn logs and symptoms into a reproducible debugging plan.
skills.prompt: Diagnose the issue using only the supplied evidence. Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses, identify likely root causes, and give a minimal step-by-step reproduction and fix plan.

skills.name: Architecture Designer
skills.description: Design modular system architecture and interfaces.
skills.prompt: Design a modular architecture. Include component boundaries, interfaces, data flow, failure handling, security boundaries, and a phased implementation plan.

skills.name: Test Planner
skills.description: Generate unit, integration, UI and regression tests.
skills.prompt: Create a test plan with unit, integration, security, performance, regression and manual device tests. Include test data, expected results and edge cases.

skills.name: API Designer
skills.description: Design stable REST and local IPC contracts.
skills.prompt: Design an API contract with request/response schemas, validation, errors, versioning, authentication and example calls.

skills.name: README Writer
skills.description: Create clear installation and project documentation.
skills.prompt: Write a practical README with overview, prerequisites, install steps, configuration, usage, troubleshooting, security notes and contribution guidance.

skills.name: Release Notes
skills.description: Prepare versioned release notes from supplied changes.
skills.prompt: Create concise release notes grouped into Added, Changed, Fixed, Security, Known Limitations and Upgrade Instructions. Do not invent changes.

skills.name: Project Planner
skills.description: Convert a project idea into phases and deliverables.
skills.prompt: Convert the idea into a delivery plan with milestones, scope, dependencies, acceptance criteria, risks and a realistic MVP.

skills.name: Requirements Analyst
skills.description: Turn rough requirements into verifiable requirements.
skills.prompt: Extract functional and non-functional requirements. Give each a unique ID, priority, acceptance criteria and open questions.

skills.name: Security Audit
skills.description: Threat model the supplied system.
skills.prompt: Perform a defensive security review. Identify assets, trust boundaries, attack surfaces, threats, mitigations and residual risks. Do not suggest offensive exploitation.

skills.name: Privacy Reviewer
skills.description: Review data collection, retention and sharing.
skills.prompt: Review privacy implications: data minimization, local storage, cloud transfer, retention, secrets, permissions, backup and user consent.

skills.name: Local Model Selector
skills.description: Recommend models based on device RAM and task.
skills.prompt: Recommend local models based on the exact device RAM, available storage, quantization, context length and task. Use conservative memory estimates and clearly label unverified performance.

skills.name: Provider Advisor
skills.description: Compare local and cloud inference routes.
skills.prompt: Compare configured local and remote AI options. Consider privacy, cost, rate limits, latency, model capability, network reliability and data policy. Never assume free access is unlimited.

skills.name: Prompt Optimizer
skills.description: Improve prompts while preserving intent.
skills.prompt: Rewrite the supplied prompt to be precise, structured and testable. Preserve all requirements and list assumptions separately.

skills.name: Conversation Summarizer
skills.description: Summarize long conversations into actionable context.
skills.prompt: Summarize the conversation into objective, decisions, requirements, completed work, unresolved issues, risks and next actions. Preserve exact names and constraints.

skills.name: Study Tutor
skills.description: Teach a topic with examples and short exercises.
skills.prompt: Teach the topic progressively. Start with a simple explanation, then an example, common mistakes, and a short practice exercise with answer.

skills.name: Urdu + English Explainer
skills.description: Explain technical subjects in simple English and Roman Urdu.
skills.prompt: Explain the technical subject in simple English followed by clear Roman Urdu. Keep commands and code exact, and define important terms.

skills.name: Workflow Builder
skills.description: Design a human-approved workflow with checkpoints.
skills.prompt: Design a workflow with explicit trigger, inputs, steps, approvals, outputs, failure recovery and audit events. Never include hidden or unapproved device actions.

skills.name: Donation Page Writer
skills.description: Write transparent optional donation messaging.
skills.prompt: Draft ethical, transparent donation messaging. Make donations optional, explain what they support, avoid manipulative claims, and do not promise features that are not implemented.
